svg.aria-label: Project 01: ForensicaLite, NTFS disk forensics toolkit. A raw-disk NTFS forensic analyzer in pure Python. It recovers deleted files, detects timestomping and rebuilds file history, without touching the OS file APIs.

g.text: A disk forensics toolkit, a deployed fintech platform and an offline classroom lab, each taken from

and rebuilds file history, without touching the OS file APIs.
